description: Plan tier, credits remaining, and every quota/count dimension tracked against it for the caller's organization. FREE: reads counters this codebase already maintains for its own gating — nothing here calls a paid provider or spends a credit. `gatingActive` is false on a self-hosted deployment with no billing provider configured: `tier`, `creditsRemaining` and `quotas` are all null there, not a fabricated tier. `counts` (projects/rank-tracked keywords/API keys) is always populated. Inside a quota dimension, `used: null` means NOT TRACKED — an unlimited tier's counter is never incremented in the first place — never a real zero; `used: 0` IS a real measured zero. `aiGatewayOps` is the shared platform AI-gateway key's own monthly ceiling, reported separately because it is a platform-abuse ceiling, not a plan entitlement.
name: get_usage
